notablePrerequisites:
You have a nonartifact Minotaur creature card in hand.
You control at least three Minotaurs, one of which must be a nontoken, nonartifact creature.
description:
Activate Didgeridoo by paying {3}, putting any nonartifact Minotaur from your hand onto the battlefield.
The Minotaur enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Minotaur you control.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning any other nontoken, nonartifact Minotaur from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
